Changelog

nbzinbHossen 0.1.0

First release, submitted for the STA 651 final project.

Model fitting

  • nbreg() fits negative binomial (NB2) regression by IRLS for the coefficients alternated with Newton-Raphson on log(theta). It agrees with MASS::glm.nb() to about 1e-7.
  • zinbreg() fits zero-inflated negative binomial regression by an EM algorithm whose M-steps are IRLS fits, with two-part formulas y ~ count | zero. It agrees with pscl::zeroinfl(dist = "negbin") to about 1e-5.
  • ZINB standard errors come from an analytic Hessian of the observed-data log-likelihood; zinbreg_control(hessian = "numerical") uses numDeriv::hessian() instead.
  • No general-purpose optimizer (optim(), nlm(), …) and no glm() / lm() fitting code is used.

Methods

  • print(), summary(), coef(), vcov(), logLik(), fitted(), residuals(), nobs() and predict() for both classes; AIC() and BIC() work through logLik().
  • predict.zinbreg() supports type = "response", "count", "zero" and "prob", with newdata.
  • plot() for zinbreg fits shows the observed-data log-likelihood at every EM iteration, or its distance to the final value on a log scale.

Checks

  • 87 tests compare both fitting functions with the reference implementations and cover offsets, weights, warnings and input errors.
  • Benchmark and simulation scripts are in inst/benchmark/.
